create_forward_context: create a forward context with attention metadata, vLLM config, and optional DP metadata for a model forward pass
set_forward_context: set a forward context as the current active context for the duration of a model forward pass with batchsize tracking
get_forward_context: get the current active forward context used during model inference
override_forward_context: override the current forward context temporarily for a specific forward pass using a context manager
build_batch_descriptor: build a batch descriptor for CUDA graph dispatching with token count, request count, and LoRA configuration
build_dp_metadata: build DP metadata for data-parallel MoE inference with token counts across data parallel ranks
test_is_forward_context_available: test whether a forward context is currently set and available for model inference
